#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only V1.4 baseline inspection and future command inventory.

No subprocess, output writes, candidate/proposal/review creation or installation.
A command listing is not authorization to execute a later mutation.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json

ROOT = Path("/home/dobo/work/_worktrees/cat_de_roman_esti/codex__content-v1-4")
TOOLS = Path("/home/dobo/work/_temp/codex__content-v1-4/readiness/bin")
EXPECTED = {
    "go-backend/internal/contentrails/sources/authored-v3.json": "56ef795c811a3f97c8c3fe96cf1b658e836babbf9fd88fe841c986ba7e65d4cc",
    "go-backend/internal/contentrails/sources/installed-authorities.json": "8d9245f861bba03718213900984d2f2829d4d584d43bac701e5c3167ded623bf",
    "cat_de_roman_esti/fixtures/kg_sample.json": "d035f616b4aef5077d77d9cbbdefbd74c1ce2b360a1874a0533a0bd43bb04f63",
    "go-backend/internal/content/bundled.json": "b9189ef3befe94978dc2ddfc180f463a34556982178ee378f679cc83bc2cea6f",
}

def main():
    actual = {}
    for path, expected in EXPECTED.items():
        full = ROOT / path
        if not full.is_file() or full.is_symlink():
            raise SystemExit("STOP: baseline input missing/nonregular")
        actual[path] = hashlib.sha256(full.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        if actual[path] != expected:
            raise SystemExit("STOP: baseline changed; refresh readiness after independent review")
    source4 = ROOT / "go-backend/internal/contentrails/sources/authored-v4.json"
    if source4.exists():
        raise SystemExit("STOP: source4 now exists; this is a preparation-only baseline helper")
    commands = [[str(TOOLS / "cat-content"), "validate", "--root", str(ROOT)],
                [str(TOOLS / "cat-content"), "export", "--root", str(ROOT), "--check"],
                [str(TOOLS / "cat-content-rail"), "all", "--root", str(ROOT), "--check"],
                [str(TOOLS / "cat-content-ops"), "rank", "--root", str(ROOT), "--check"],
                [str(TOOLS / "cat-content-ops"), "derive", "--root", str(ROOT), "--check"],
                [str(TOOLS / "cat-mobile-pack"), "--root", str(ROOT), "--check"]]
    print(json.dumps({"baseline_hashes": actual, "source4_present": False,
                     "required_source4_parent_sha256": EXPECTED["go-backend/internal/contentrails/sources/authored-v3.json"],
                     "readonly_commands_not_executed": commands, "native_actions_executed": 0,
                     "gate": "Graph proposal/independent acceptance/applied actual hash/source4/raw/final reviews are not available or authorized by research."}, indent=2))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
